Package version: 1.9.17379 (Windows x64 release)

Released by Discord: 2026-06-30

The repository keeps only the Windows x64 runtime, import library, public headers, and Discord's
license notices from the multi-platform SDK archive. Tools for Steam loads the runtime through the
documented C API in cdiscord.h. See License-Notices.txt for Discord's notices and bundled licenses.
